options_intro: Everything is set up in the app itself — no configuration files. This guide walks through every page: Recordings, Cameras, Detectors and Settings.
use_rec_desc: Every detection appears here with a photo and a short video clip, grouped per day.
use_rec_1: Click a recording to open the viewer. With the arrow keys you step through all recordings.
use_rec_2: With 👍 and 👎 you give your own verdict: Confirmed or False alarm. Press your choice again to remove it.
use_rec_3: The chips at the top filter by category (for example Mounts or Calvings) and by result. Press a chosen chip again to clear it.
use_rec_4: The bin in the viewer removes a recording from the computer, after asking once.
use_rec_5: Export downloads a ZIP of the current filter, optionally between two dates. Only the original photos makes a small ZIP to share with the people who train the models.
use_rec_caption: Recordings: every detection with confidence, category and your review.
use_rec_viewer_caption: The viewer plays the clip with the detection box; confirm or mark it as a false alarm.
use_cam_desc: The live pictures of all cameras, with the latest detection boxes on top.
use_cam_1: Live shows up to four live pictures at a time; click Show live picture for the others. A camera shows its first picture at its next keyframe, which can take a few seconds.
use_cam_2: The label on each picture shows which detector watches the camera. Live view only means no detector is watching it.
use_cam_3: History shows per camera when it was really watched over the last hour, day or week. Every recording is a mark on the line; a gap tells you why nothing was noticed: camera offline, monitoring paused or AI Detector not running.
use_cam_4: Add camera searches the network again, or lets you enter a stream URL yourself.
use_cam_caption: Cameras → Live: every camera with the detector that watches it.
use_cam_history_caption: Cameras → History: green is watched, marks are recordings, gaps show why nothing was seen.
use_det_desc: A detector links cameras, an AI model and alert recipients together.
use_det_1: Click a detector to change its preset, name, cameras, Telegram recipients and AI check. Changes only apply after Save detector.
use_det_2: A detector made from a preset follows that preset: when a newer model is published, the detector takes it within a day or at the next start. Your cameras and alerts stay as they are.
use_det_3: Switch off Update automatically in a detector to keep the model it has.
use_det_4: Calving Catcher has a Low Power mode: it looks less often, asks less of the computer and can notice an event a little later.
use_det_5: Changed detection settings yourself? Then the detector keeps them and is no longer updated. Choose the preset again to follow it.
use_det_caption: Detectors: each detector with its cameras and alert recipients.
use_det_edit_caption: A detector: choose a preset, a name and the cameras it watches.
use_status_desc: The status at the top left is always visible. Click it to see per camera whether fresh pictures are being analysed right now.
use_status_1: A camera only counts as monitored when fresh pictures are really being analysed by every detector assigned to it.
use_status_2: Pause monitoring stops detection, and keeps it paused at the next start too.
use_status_3: A detector that stops is started again by itself. If it keeps failing, every page shows that monitoring has stopped and why.
use_status_4: Heartbeat: the detector calls an address you choose (for example Healthchecks.io or Uptime Kuma) while it runs. You get a warning when the calls stop — the only warning that also works when the computer is off or has no internet.
use_status_caption: Monitoring status: every camera with the time of its last analysed picture.
use_alerts_desc: Under Settings → Alerts you manage everyone who gets a Telegram message.
use_alerts_1: Each recipient chooses which detectors alert them. One bot can serve several chats.
use_alerts_2: Quiet hours: alerts between two times arrive without sound, for example at night. Leave both empty for sound at any hour.
use_alerts_3: Camera offline notifications (off by default): after five minutes without monitoring, the camera’s recipients get a message, and again when it is back.
use_alerts_4: Send test alert checks that a recipient still works.
use_alerts_caption: Settings → Alerts: recipients and camera offline notifications.
use_alerts_quiet_caption: A recipient with quiet hours from 22:00 to 06:00.
use_ai_desc: Optional: let a vision language model double-check each clip before an alert is sent.
use_ai_1: Connect Google Gemini with a key from Google AI Studio. Other providers are set under Advanced → AI connections.
use_ai_2: A connection is saved once and used by any number of detectors, each with its own question.
use_ai_3: The recording shows whether the AI check confirmed or rejected the event.
use_ai_caption: Settings → AI check: without a connection, every detection is recorded and alerted as it is.
use_devices_desc: Open the dashboard on any phone or computer on the same network.
use_devices_1: Go to http://aidetector.local/ or http://<computer-IP>/. Is port 80 already in use? Then the app moves to :8080 or the next free number. The QR code under Settings → Devices always opens the right address.
use_devices_2: Every new browser needs a one-time code from Settings → Devices. The computer AI Detector runs on is always trusted.
use_devices_3: On an iPhone or iPad you can add the app to your home screen. On Android, Settings → Home screen shortcut explains how to add a link.
use_devices_caption: Settings → Devices: the connected browsers, each with a button to remove access.
use_storage_desc: Recordings are kept until you remove them. Nothing is deleted automatically.
use_storage_1: Settings → Storage shows the free space and removes recordings from before a date you choose. Export the ones you want to keep first.
use_storage_2: Clear model cache removes prepared models and unused downloads. Pause monitoring first.
use_storage_3: Settings → Back up downloads your cameras, detectors and alert settings. It contains camera passwords and tokens: keep it safe. Restore it with Use existing setup in a new installation.
use_storage_4: Can a settings file not be read? Every page then offers Recover settings, which restores the last valid settings.
use_storage_caption: Settings → Storage: free space, removing old recordings and the model cache.
use_settings_caption: Settings: alerts, AI check, devices, storage, advanced, language, appearance and back-up.
use_more_desc: For everyone who wants to fine-tune or needs help.
use_more_1: Advanced lets you edit thresholds, prompts and the detection engine as JSON. Only needed for special situations; presets set everything for you.
use_more_2: Logs shows recent activity. Download diagnostics bundles logs, system details and redacted settings for a bug report.
use_more_3: Language: English, Nederlands, Deutsch or Français — for every device and for the Telegram replies.
use_more_5: Updates: on Windows and Mac via Check for Updates in the AI Detector menu; on Ubuntu by installing the new package; with Docker via docker compose pull.
options_github_text: Read the complete application guide, report a bug or follow new releases on the official GitHub page of AI Detector.
